author: Ogrey
body:
Hey guys.
As you may have noticed, there are currently two four-teamed DTM maps in rotations.
These maps are Mute City 1 and Mute City 2, maps that I haven't released in forums, until now.
This thread is basically some sort of "group release" for Mute City 1, Mute City 2, and the new and just-finished Mute City 3.
Please read the signs in front of your respective team-spawns if you have difficulties playing this map. Thanks a lot <3

I'll leave images of maps down here:

##### Mute City 1 #####




##### Mute City 2 #####



##### Mute City 3 #####
